tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la mkhas pa red mda' ba chen po sogs kyis rtsod pa'i lan rtsod bzlog tu grags pa la bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī ka la tsakra ya/ khyab bdag dpal ldan 'gyur med bde ba'i dngos/ /rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya'i gzi 'bar zhing / /srid dang srid min dbyer med mgon de dang / /mi gnyis bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gangs can 'di na dus 'khor la/ /dmigs pa'i log rtog chu 'dzin las/ /'ongs pa'i nyes spyod klog 'phreng dang / /log smra'i ser ba mi bzad pas/ /phan bde'i lo thog 'joms byed pa'i/ /mkhas rlom du ma 'di skad du/ /rgyud 'di rtsod bcas yin pas na/ /mkhas pas blang bya ma yin lo/ /'di ni dpal ldan zhi ba lhas/ /theg chen rtsod bcas phyir zhe na/ /lung la mu stegs pa rnams dang / /lung gzhan la yang rang gzhan dag /rtsod bcas yin phyir dor byar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i rigs pas legs par bcom/ /gzhung lugs gzhan la mkhas rnams kyis/ /blor ma chug pas skyon bcas lo/ /theg chen dbu ma chen po de/ /dbyig gnyen thugs su ma chug phyir/ /dbu ma spong bar cis mi byed/ /thig chen nyan thos sde pa yis/ /sangs rgyas gsung du mi 'dod pas/ /byams pa klu grub zhi ba lha/ /legs ldan 'byed sogs mkhas pa yis/ /theg chen bka' bsgrub rig pa'i tshogs/ /mang du bkod phyir thig chen kun/ /rtsod bcas chos su cis mi 'dod/ /khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg /rgyal ba'i gsung du mi 'dod pa/ /'phags yul du yang du ma byung / /de phyir mkhas mchog shān+ti ba/ /sogs kyis gsang sngags bka' bsgrub mdzad/ /spyir yang dman pa mi mos pas/ /mchog tu grub ces byams mgon gsung / /de phyir mkhas pa gzhon blo yis/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsod yig tu/ /bkod pa'i rig pa ma lus pa/ /ltar snang kho nar kho bos mthong / /de yang legs par bshad kyis nyon/ /e waṃ yi ge med pas na/

/rtsa rgyud rnam dag min zer ba/ /e waṃ gzugs don med zer ba/ /dang po khyab pa ma grub ste/ /bde mchog la sogs skyon du 'jug /gnyis pa gtan tshigs ma grub ste/ /sangs rgyas seng ge'i khrir bzhugs phyir/ /khyab ste bshad rgyud rdor phreng las/ /e ni gsang ba mkha' dbyings dang / /bha ga pad+ma chos 'byung dang / /chos kyi dbyings dang seṅge'i khri/ /mchog tu rmad byung brjod par byed/ /waṃ ni rdo rje rdo rje sems/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug che/ /he ru ka dang dus 'khor ro/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs mtshan/ /zhes pas gsal bar gsungs phyir ro/ /'dis ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan/ /rgyud sde gzhan du ma smos zhes/ /mu cor smra ba de yang bsal/ /de phyir e waṃ ma smos zhes/ /rtsa rgyud sogs su bshad pa ni/ /e waṃ gzugs la dgos pa yin/ /'dis ni dus 'khor bde mchog gi /gzhal yas khang la chos 'byung gi /gru gsum dbyibs can mi byed pa'i/ /rgyu mtshan de yang gsal bar bshad/ /mngon shes med pas rtsa rgyud kyi/ /dang po'i 'grel pa byar mi rung / /zhes gsungs pa la 'chad po yang / /mngon shes dgos par mtshungs zer ba/ /dang po'i 'chad pa sbyor na 'dod/ /mi sbyor khyab pa ji ltar mtshungs/ /skyes bu nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / /'byung pa 'gro ba'i skye gnas dang / /ljon shing dud 'gro'i skye bar bsdus/ /stong pa'i rdul gyis 'jig rten rtsom/ /'di rnams mu stegs gzhung lugs dang / /mthun phyir dam chos min no lo/ /des 'dul drang srong rjes gzung phyir/ /de lta'i tha snyad khas len kyang / /don rnams cung zad mi bzhed de/ /rtag dngos khas mi len phyir dang / /'byung pa nyer len min phyir du/ /ljon shing skye gnas bzhir bsdus pas/ /dud 'gror bsdus par mi 'gyur phyir/ /'jig rten bstan bzhag mngon pa dang / /'gal ba'i phyir na mi 'thad lo/ /chu 'bab klung la yi dwags rnams/

/rnag khrag shes pa skye ba bzhin/ /sems can so so'i las dang ni/ /bag chags stobs kyis dngos po gcig /tshad dbyibs 'gal bar snang ba 'di/ /lung rig du mas grub bzhin du/ /tshul 'di snang smras byed pa'i rgyu/ /bag chags ngan pa rtsis ma yin/ /'on kyang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon yod pa/ /'gog pa lta bur mdzad pa ni/ /des 'dul drang srong gzung phyir yin/ /sgra mi snyan du kla klo dang / /rigs ldan 'byung phyir dge sdig gnyis/ /'byung la'ang mngon pas gnod zer ba/ /'du shes med pa'i sems can rnams/ /sher phyin 'char par 'od 'gyur zhing / /sher phyin mdo las bshad pa dang / /srog dbang chad pa slar mthud par/ /sman bla'i mdo las bshad pa dang / /bud med rten la 'tshang rgya bar/ /gsang 'dus sogs las bshad rnams la/ /mngon pa'i lung gis cis mi gnod/ /gling bzhi mtha' dag mngon pa dang / /mi bstun pa nyid nges bzhin du/ /sgra mi snyan la dod dpyod pa'i/ /blo gros 'di 'dra e ma mtshar/ /'dul ba lung las rgyal ba yis/ /rta chag rul pa bzhes pa dang / /seng dan tshal pa zug pa dang / /gyogs kyis sku rgyab gnad pa dang / /'khor lo'i dbyen gyis btsen pa sogs/ /las kyi lhag dmar bshad pa dang / /dbang po gnyis sbyor sogs bkag cing / /theg chen lung las gnang ba dang / /las sgrib zad par spangs pa sogs/ /'gal ba spong yang mi shes sam/ /'dzag bde 'khor ba'i rgyur bshad pas/ /tsha dmyal khams gong la sogs na/ /'dzag bde med pas mi 'thad lo/ /'dzag bde yin na khams drug can/ /rags pa yin pas ma khyab ste/ /de la yon tan lnga ldan nas/ /gcig ldan bar gyi phra rags su/ /phye nas mi dang lha sogs la/ /rim par sbyar nas gsungs phyir ro/ /de na de ni 'gyur bde yin/ /mi 'gyur bde ba thar lam gyi/ /rtsa bar nges bzhin 'gyur bde ni/ /'khor ba'i rtsa bar cis mi 'dod/ /des na don de drang don du/

/bshad pa'ang rgyud la bskur 'debs yin/ /kun+da byang chub sems spong ba/ /rtsa ltung yin na khyim pa yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mi 'thad lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'thad ldan gyis/ /kun+da spong ba mi srid de/ /gsang dbang sogs la 'byin srid kyang / /bde chen steng du mi dgos zhes/ /spong sems skye ba ga la srid/ /skyes na rtsa ltung 'byung nges te/ /lam gyi rtsa ba'i rten sa ni/ /dper na smon sems gtong ba bzhin/ /rig byed bzhi dang grub mtha' bzhi/ /mi rigs bzhi sogs dus 'khor gyi/ /zhal bzhi po las 'byung bshad pas/ /tshangs pa'i gzhung dang 'dra zer ba/ /'bras bu'i dus 'khor lha sku yi/ /zhal las 'byung ba mi 'dod kyi/ /nges don gzhi yi dus 'khor gang / /gnyug ma'i thig le gzhom med la/ /gnas skabs bzhi po bskyed pa yi/ /nus pa'i sgo bzhi bskyed po de/ /lus kyi snying kha la sogs pa'i/ /'khor lo bzhi la gnas pa yi/ /bag chags sad pas phyi rol gyi/ /snang ba bzhi tshan 'char bas na/ /gzhi yi dus 'khor zhal bzhi las/ /'byung bar gsung phyir snang ba kun/ /phyi na tshugs thub med tshul la/ /nges pa ster bas mchog tu grub/ /gzung 'dzin dgos pas 'di mi go /brjod tu med pa'i gang zag ni/ /bye brag smra bas 'dod pa dang / /kha che'i gzhung gis bdag med par/ /'dod pa khas blangs 'gal zer ba/ /bye brag smra la kha che bas/ /khyab par 'dod pa bab col yin/ /de la thams cad yod smra yis/ /khyab ces zer ba'ang de dang 'dra/ /gnas ma bu sogs sde pa lnga/ /bdag 'di 'dod ces smra ba dang / /grub mtha' bzhi ru ma gtogs na/ /nang pa min par smra ba dang / /sde pa bco brgyad thub bstan la/ /gyes par smras rnams cis mi 'gal/ /rang gi nang 'gal mi rigs pa'i/ /sa bcu pa la nang 'gal 'dzin/ /mdo sde pa yi rnam rig min/ /las gzhan thogs med gzugs 'dod ces/ /zer ba'ang shin tu mi rigs te/ /yang na dbang don gang rung zhig

/thogs med nyid du 'dod pa 'am/ /dbang don rig byed min pa las/ /gzhan pa'i thogs med gzugs 'dod pa'i/ /don smra de 'dra e ma mtshar/ /bsdud pos theg gsum bsdus pa dang / /glegs bam yi ger bris pa dang / /bod tu bod skad bris pa sogs/ /byis pa'i dgos pa bkod par zad/ /lwa ba pa yi u rgyan nas/ /blangs pa'i rgyud rnams tshad ldan du/ /nges nas dus zhabs la sogs la/ /sdang ba'ang sdang shugs tsam du zad/ /mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen gyis/ /kye rdor nges don 'chad pa na/ /rgyud sde 'di nyid gtsor mdzad pas/ /tshad ma'i skyes bus 'di bzung ngo / /shes rab rin chen lo ts+tsha ba'i/ /rnam dpyod mkha' shar nyi ma 'o/ /des na log lta'i rab rib rnams/ /yang dag rigs pa 'dis sel shog/ //maṅga laṃ/ bha wastu/ shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 stag tshang lo tsā ba/ dus 'khor rtsod lan rtsod bzlog tu grags pa PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
